reference_resolution.rule: Reference resolution is typed. Each operational reference is interpreted according to its declared kind and root: REPOSITORY_RELATIVE at the repository top (and must resolve inside this branch's tree), GIT_OBJECT_REVISION in the Git object database, PACKAGE_RELATIVE at the named package/worktree root, EXTERNAL_ABSOLUTE as a labelled external non-portable pointer, SOURCE_LOCAL_SHORTHAND by the named owning artifact. No single global namespace applies to all references.

REPOSITORY_RELATIVE.definition: Path rooted at the repository top level; must resolve inside this branch's tree.
REPOSITORY_RELATIVE.resolution: exist inside the branch tree; hash-checkable from the repo root

GIT_OBJECT_REVISION.definition: Revision:path reference resolved by Git itself (object database), not by the filesystem.
GIT_OBJECT_REVISION.portability: portable with the repository's object database

PACKAGE_RELATIVE.definition: Path rooted at a named package/worktree root that is not the repository top; the root must be named.
PACKAGE_RELATIVE.root: named per reference (e.g. the original dirty worktree, or an external evidence archive)
PACKAGE_RELATIVE.portability: portable only within that named package
PACKAGE_RELATIVE.resolution: join the named root and the relative path; hash-checkable there

EXTERNAL_ABSOLUTE.definition: Host-local absolute path used purely as an external provenance/evidence pointer.
EXTERNAL_ABSOLUTE.portability: NOT portable; external; never branch content
EXTERNAL_ABSOLUTE.resolution: existence may be verified on this host only

SOURCE_LOCAL_SHORTHAND.definition: Shorthand whose meaning is fixed by a named owning artifact/context (e.g. a JSON pointer into the frozen corpus, or a directory set under the original worktree).
SOURCE_LOCAL_SHORTHAND.root: the named owning artifact/context, stated per reference
